items.title: 의료 AI 정식등재 내년 1분기 윤곽...임시등재 기업들 전환 분수령
items.excerpt: 정부가 AI 의료기술의 건강보험 정식등재체계 마련에 착수하면서, 임시등재된 의료 AI 기술들이 내년 1분기 정식 급여 전환 여부를 가르는 분수령을 맞는다.

items.title: 무릎 심사에 'AI 판독' 활용한 심평원…이의신청까지 확대하나
items.excerpt: 심평원은 9월부터 무릎관절 진료비 심사에 AI 영상 판독 결과를 활용하고 척추·요로결석으로 확대할 계획이지만, AI 판독과 심사자 판단의 일치율·오판독 검증 자료는 아직 없다.

items.title: 일산백병원, AI 기반 중환자 상태 악화 예측 솔루션 도입
items.excerpt: 일산백병원이 에이아이트릭스의 AITRICS-VC(바이탈케어)를 도입했다. 활력징후 6종, 혈액검사 11종, 의식 상태, 나이 등 19개 항목으로 중환자 상태 악화 위험을 예측한다.

items.title: Who's responsible when clinical AI goes wrong? AMA weighs in
items.excerpt: The American Medical Association released a new framework laying out how developers, health systems and physicians should share liability when clinical AI causes harm, building on its recent governance guidance.

items.title: Counsel Health launches AI-native weight management program, inks partnership with Lilly Direct
items.excerpt: AI-native primary care company Counsel Health launched a weight management program pairing GLP-1 obesity medications with on-demand physicians and AI-driven care, with access through LillyDirect.

items.title: FDA, CMS scramble to avoid regulatory logjam as more states look to test AI in clinical settings
items.excerpt: Federal officials are moving behind the scenes to head off a conflict as states set up regulatory sandboxes to test AI in clinical care that run into FDA and CMS rules.

items.title: FDA clears AI tool for assessing breast cancer recurrence risk via MRI
items.excerpt: SimBioSys received FDA clearance for TumorSight Risk, AI software that estimates breast cancer recurrence risk from MRI.

items.title: Radiology societies weigh in on FDA's push to regulate generative AI
items.excerpt: RSNA and other radiology societies filed comments on FDA's approach to generative-AI-enabled devices, urging that patient safety stay central and that regulatory flexibility come with enforceable safeguards. (Follow-up to the covered FDA comment-period story.)

items.title: Coronary plaque imaging keeps improving thanks to advanced AI, photon-counting CT
items.excerpt: AI now automates CCTA plaque measurements that used to be slow manual work, and combined with photon-counting CT it is changing how clinicians assess coronary plaque.

items.title: FDA clears Deep Reasoning AI's neurovascular CTA software
items.excerpt: Deep Reasoning AI received FDA 510(k) clearance for NeuroDR, which runs automatically after a head-and-neck CTA, removes bone, soft tissue and veins, and sends 3D vessel reconstructions to PACS.

items.title: Brainomix highlights AI study on stroke drug responders
items.excerpt: A study using Brainomix's automated noncontrast CT analysis helped identify large hemispheric infarction patients who could benefit from intravenous glyburide.

items.title: SIIM-CAIMI: Apollo LLM framework shows promise in patient monitoring
items.excerpt: Harvard's Apollo multimodal foundation model, trained on 25 billion records from 7.2 million patients, beats 26 established clinical risk scores and predicts disease onset up to five years ahead.

items.title: Accuracy and impact of an AI safety system for missed specialist referrals in primary care
items.excerpt: Researchers built MR-AI, which flags missed specialist referrals in consultation notes, and evaluated it in a quasi-experimental study across seven primary care clinics.

items.title: A clinical multimodal vision language foundation model with fine-grain explainability
items.excerpt: EVLF-FM, a multimodal vision-language foundation model, achieved higher diagnostic accuracy and better explainability across diverse imaging modalities to support clinical decisions.

items.title: Development, validation and AI chatbot evaluation of the Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool
items.excerpt: Clinicians built AMHART to grade how AI chatbots respond to teens disclosing anxiety or depression. Testing four widely used chatbots exposed gaps in how they respond.

items.title: [미래 헬스케어 트렌드] 숨빗AI 백재민 이사 "AI가 판독문 초안 작성, 전문의는 검토·수정…판독 시간 42% 줄였다"
items.excerpt: AI가 영상 판독문 초안을 쓰고 전문의가 검토·수정하는 방식으로 판독 시간을 42% 줄인 현장 사례를 숨빗AI가 소개했다(메디게이트 미래 헬스케어 트렌드 컨퍼런스 강연 시리즈).

items.title: 용인세브란스병원, 흉부 엑스레이로 심장 기능 저하 예측 AI 개발
items.excerpt: 용인세브란스병원 연구팀이 흉부 X-ray로 좌심실 박출률 저하를 예측하는 AI를 개발했다. 루닛 인사이트 CXR 결과를 활용한 하이브리드 모델의 AUROC는 0.85로, 심장초음파가 어려운 소규모 의료기관에서 쓸 수 있다.

items.title: 삼성전자, 갤럭시 워치 수면 무호흡 기능 고도화…FDA이어 식약처 허가 획득
items.excerpt: 삼성전자가 갤럭시 워치의 AI 기반 수면 무호흡 기능을 고도화해 식약처 허가를 받았다. 징후 유무만 보던 기존 기능과 달리 시간당 호흡 장애 횟수로 경미·중등도·중증을 구분한다.

items.title: Partnering with Singapore to bring frontier AI to public health
items.excerpt: Google announced a Singapore research hub and initiatives to support clinicians, advance health research and bring frontier AI to the country's public health system.
